Name: Conversation Topic Utilities (CTU)
Author: BarleyZP
Description:
[size=3][size=4]About[/size]

Conversation Topic Utilities (CTU) is a framework for modders that want more flexibility out of their conversation topic dialogue lines. It does nothing on its own. If you're a player using a mod that requires this one, simply install it as you would any other mod and enjoy playing!

Mod authors: check out the [url=https://github.com/lisyce/StardewValleyMods/blob/main/Conversation%20Topic%20Utilities/docs/author-guide.md]Author Guide[/url] for full documentation! You can take advantage of all of the features of this mod with only Content Patcher edits!

Available features include:

[list]
[*] Mark conversation topics (and optionally their memories too) as repeatable every time they expire
[*] Default dialogue lines for a topic: allow many NPCs to have shared default lines for a topic, with conditions that specify who can use those defaults and when they use the defaults.
[*] The ability to match many conversation topics at once for default/repeatable dialogue lines (to avoid duplicate code)
[*] A trigger action to immediately mark a conversation topic as repeatable again
[/list]

[size=4]Example Usecases[/size]

[list]
[*] Mark all topics that start with your mod's unique Id as repeatable every time they expire
[*] Create a default dialogue line that any NPC can use in response to a specific conversation topic, but only if it's raining outside
[*] Create a default dialogue line that an NPC only uses if their name is included in the conversation topic key (e.g. Sam only responds to the topic "myTopic_Sam" and not "myTopic_Pierre")
[*]Create a topic that can be repeated once per season using the new trigger action
[/list]

[size=4]Source Code[/size]

Source available on [url=https://github.com/lisyce/StardewValleyMods/tree/main/Conversation%20Topic%20Utilities]GitHub[/url].
[/size]
